Class SpinObjectValueSerializer

org.finos.fluxnova.bpm.engine.impl.variable.serializer.AbstractTypedValueSerializer<ObjectValue>

All Implemented Interfaces:
TypedValueSerializer<ObjectValue>
public class SpinObjectValueSerializer extends AbstractObjectValueSerializer
Implementation of a TypedValueSerializer for ObjectValues using a Spin-provided DataFormat to serialize and deserialize java objects.
